text:
The owner of TG Jones is exploring a potential sale less than 18 months after completing a deal to buy the high street chain formerly known as WH Smith.
Modella Capital, which also owns businesses including Hobbycraft, completed a deal to buy the 233-year-old business for £76m in June last year.
The company, which pushed through a swingeing restructure to close more than 100 stores after receiving high court approval in July, has moved to appoint advisers after receiving unsolicited expressions of interest for the business.
Modella, which has closed about 150 of the 480 WH Smith stores since taking control, has appointed the corporate finance arm of Teneo, according to Sky News which first reported the news.
“High-street retailer TG Jones has received unsolicited offers for the business,” said Modella and TG Jones in a joint statement. “Management and owner Modella Capital have jointly agreed to instruct Teneo Corporate Finance to review these offers and undertake a market-testing exercise.”
An auction of the business, which employs about 3,500 staff, is planned for next year to avoid disruption through the key Christmas trading period.
“As ever, our focus is on providing a great experience for customers, especially with the critical Christmas period coming up,” said the TG Jones chief executive, Alex Wilson. “We continue to execute our turnaround plan, which is improving our performance month by month.”
WH Smith retained its almost 1,300 stores in train stations and airports, as well as its website and the right to its name, promoting the rebrand of the high street stores to TG Jones.
The potential sale comes as the future of Poundland, which employs approximately 12,000 people and operates 600 stores in the UK and Ireland, remains uncertain.
Last week the chain’s owner, Gordon Brothers, won approval from the high court for an extension of legal protection from creditors as it assesses three potential bids.
Last month its US owners filed a notice of intention to call in administrators, but has come under pressure to accept a bid for the company that would save retail jobs and protect thousands of suppliers.
digest_he:
בעלי רשת החנויות TG Jones החלו בבחינת אפשרות למכירת העסק, פחות מ-18 חודשים לאחר השלמת עסקת הרכישה של הרשת הוותיקה. החברה האם, מודלה קפיטל, מינתה את זרוע המימון התאגידי של פירמת Teneo לצורך בחינת הצעות לא רשמיות שהתקבלו וניהול תהליך בדיקת שוק.

במסגרת תוכנית ההתאוששות של הרשת, המעסיקה כ-3,500 עובדים, נסגרו כבר למעלה מ-100 סניפים לאחר אישור בית המשפט. מכירה פומבית של הפעילות מתוכננת לשנה הבאה על מנת למנוע הפרעות לפעילות העסקית בתקופת חג המולד הקריטית.
